00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter s.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the s.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We go up in a curve, and we make a small loop to the LEFT, right at the top. Then we come back to the RIGHT: a curve, an arch, and we finish with one last curve to the left, resting on the line. All in one go, without lifting the pencil!
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with s.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with s.
